data.narrative:
Stratolaunch is a private-stage Space & Aerospace company operating within a competitive universe of 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, Impulse Space, ICEYE, and Sierra Space.

Standard triangulation methods do not yield a defensible valuation range. Peer-median analysis fails due to insufficient narrow-stage comparables: only 1 same-stage peer exists within the Space & Aerospace sector, falling well short of the 3-datapoint minimum required for statistical reliability. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied because Stratolaunch's revenue is not disclosed, preventing calculation of a meaningful revenue multiple. The Space & Aerospace sector P/S median stands at 27.4x across the 6 public tickers, but without target revenue this metric remains inapplicable.

No triangulated valuation range can be derived from the available data. Valuation of Stratolaunch would require either: (1) disclosure of historical or projected revenue to enable public-multiple anchoring, (2) access to pricing data from at least 2 additional private transactions at comparable stage and technology maturity, or (3) precedent transaction data from the aerospace manufacturing or launch services subsectors. Until such data materializes, any valuation estimate would rest on assumption rather than market evidence.
